query:
UPDATE deliveries
            SET shopping_required = TRUE,
                store_name = $2,
                store_location = CASE
                    WHEN $3::double precision IS NULL OR $4::double precision IS NULL THEN store_location
                    ELSE ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint($4::double precision, $3::double precision), 4326)::geography
                END
            WHERE id = $1
